name: Ore no Imouto ni Te, Dasu na!
source:
After intense studying, the protagonist managed to enter a prestigious school in the countryside and gain the right to live alone. He was finally enjoying his carefree solitary life, but his cute yet sassy younger sister appeared, turning his solo life upside down! Now, the cohabitation of the eccentric older brother and the cheeky younger sister begins, and who knows how things will turn out...

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ435524.html/?]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
经过刻苦学习，主人公考入乡村名校，并获得了独居的权利。好不容易享受无忧无虑的独居生活，可爱又飒的妹妹却出现了，让他的独居生活发生了翻天覆地的变化！现在，古怪的哥哥和厚脸皮的妹妹的同居开始了，谁知道事情会变成什么样子……
